data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Mina' (Moon) and 'Isha' (God). The name Minesh signifies the one who is the god of the Moon. The name Minesh carries the meaning “Moon God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Minesh usually hope their child will grow to embody moon god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Minesh is of Hindu origin and is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Mina' meaning Moon and 'Isha' meaning God. The name Minesh emphasizes the spiritual connection between the individual and the celestial body represented by the moon in Hindu mythology. This name highlights the importance of the lunar cycles and their influence on daily life, agricultural practices, and astronomical predictions.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Minesh holds significant spiritual meaning, as it implies that the bearer is considered to be the god of the Moon. This bestows upon them certain divine qualities and responsibilities. In Hindu spirituality, the moon is revered as a source of nourishment and peace, and is linked to ideas of growth, renewal, and introspection. The name evokes the god's calming influence and offers a reminder of the cyclical rhythms of life. It may inspire the bearer to embody the serenity and wisdom of the moon god.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Minesh: In Sanskrit, 'Mina' means mine or wealth, and 'esh' signifies the divine presence within. Therefore, Minesh symbolizes the individual as a vessel of the divine, possessing inner wealth and potential.

historical_references.reference: Minesh Parekh was an Indian-American entrepreneur and philanthropist. He was born in 1951 in Nadiad, Gujarat, India. He came to the United States in 1974 and studied at the University of Michigan. In 1988, he founded Partech International, a technology venture capital firm. Today, Partech is one of the most active venture capital firms in Europe.

Minesh Pitroda is an Indian engineer and politician. He was born in 1945 in Maharashtra, India. He studied at the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) in Bombay and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) in the United States. In the late 1980s, he was a key figure in the development of India's telecommunications sector. He served as the advisor to the Prime Minister of India on telecommunications and information technology from 2009 to 2011.
